SecureStore AES ciphertext inspected; offline process restart restored session; no auth tokens or session fields in AsyncStorage
Catalog selection, duplicate occurrences, ordering and key C to G persisted
Force-stop/relaunch without QA transport retained complete draft and identical pending UUID
Reconnect and retry accepted e5582b7f-b7d7-40db-8ad4-d2b36b0253cb once; initial proposal history count 1
HTTP 409 with independent API session; local G retained; explicit cancel/refresh/resend succeeded
Two accounts and two churches did not show or send another scope journal; original pending draft survived account change
Suspended membership caused actual phone PUT 403 and unchanged revision 3/history 3
Revoked QA sessions caused actual phone HTTP 401, credential removal and login screen
Service applied 3 musical occurrences with transposed G/D chords and retained 2 manual items
Explicit logout removed QA credential; owned fixtures, containers, secrets and ADB reverse cleaned

observations.finding: Account screen displays English strings despite Spanish settings, including Account, PROFILE, Your icon, Log out, Delete account
observations.evidence: Observed UIAutomator screen during the physical test; logout confirmation itself was Spanish

observations.finding: Initial forbidden church load displays generic connection/update error rather than permission-specific text

observations.finding: Initial tone picker and first re-login automation required retry; later direct runtime checks passed
observations.evidence: Phone also changed to Android Settings during testing; no LVM crash established. C to G was later verified through UI, local journal and PostgreSQL; re-login restored the original draft.

limits: One HONOR Android 16, one PC and ADB reverse; not all phones or networks
Offline means QA transport removed; phone Wi-Fi and mobile data remained unchanged
Second writer was an independent API session, not a second physical phone
No physical lost-ACK-after-commit injection; that case remains covered by the separate headless integration
SecureStore AES and session recovery verified; no independent proof of hardware-backed Keystore or locked-device behavior
TLS success verified in installed app; negative CA and hostname tests ran on host, not on Android
No store signing, distribution, main merges or production native activation
QA APK and noncredential test drafts remain in the separate com.lavozmisionera.qa package; its temporary server and CA are gone
